# Rivanta Green

> Emerging Indian industrial enterprise developing strategic capabilities across advanced materials, renewable fuels, and circular manufacturing.

Rivanta Green is an Indian industrial enterprise focused on converting underutilized agricultural residues—primarily rice husk and straw—into high-value industrial materials and clean energy vectors. The enterprise is structured around five strategic priorities: agricultural residue utilization, reducing crop-residue open burning, building domestic industrial manufacturing capabilities, reducing import dependence for strategic inputs, and advancing circular manufacturing systems.

## Industrial Development Initiatives

- [Bio-Silica & Advanced Materials](https://www.rivantagreen.com/bio-silica): Development of biogenic silica (SiO2) derived from agricultural residues; evaluating target high-purity (up to 6N / 99.9999% target) green silicon precursor pathways to strengthen domestic advanced manufacturing supply chains.
- [Compressed Biogas (CBG)](https://www.rivantagreen.com/cbg): Development of commercial anaerobic digestion and biomethane enrichment facilities to convert regional crop residues into renewable gas for mobility and industrial energy.
- [Sustainable Aviation Fuel (SAF)](https://www.rivantagreen.com/saf): Technology evaluation and preliminary assessment of sustainable aviation fuel pathways and synthesis routes from agricultural residues.
- [Feedstock & Biomass Aggregation](https://www.rivantagreen.com/feedstock): Development of structured regional procurement, aggregation, and logistics networks with millers and Farmer Producer Organizations (FPOs).
- [Industrial Infrastructure](https://www.rivantagreen.com/projects): Planning and engineering of proposed integrated manufacturing campuses with planned captive biomass cogeneration and efficient utility systems.

## Strategy, Governance & Corporate Responsibility

- [Environmental Stewardship](https://www.rivantagreen.com/sustainability): Environmental strategy offering commercial alternatives to open stubble burning, targeting reduced air pollution, circular co-product recovery, and responsible water management.
- [Corporate Vision & Purpose](https://www.rivantagreen.com/vision): Long-term alignment with national priorities: domestic manufacturing capability, clean energy transition, import substitution, and regional economic contribution.
- [About Us & Leadership](https://www.rivantagreen.com/about): Corporate identity, governance foundations, and industrial development framework.
- [Contact Corporate Desk](https://www.rivantagreen.com/contact): Direct corporate communication channels for commercial off-take, industrial partnerships, technology collaboration, and institutional inquiries.
